name: ICA MCP (unofficial)
author: kanylbullen
description: Uses ICA’s unofficial private API for shopping lists, recipes, offers and products. Requires login, can modify lists, and carries service-terms and availability risks.

quality.reason: Source review only; no runtime test or full rubric assessment. Unofficial private API; README warns of possible conflicts with ICA terms. Requires personnummer/password login and Swedish egress according to the project; BankID-only accounts are unsupported. Tokens are cached locally and tools can modify personal lists. No login, personal data access or write operation was attempted.
